title: Understanding GitHub Actions Secrets knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Understanding GitHub Actions Secrets?
options: Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
GitHub Actions secrets are protected configuration values scoped to repositories, environments, or organizations; access depends on context and policy.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
questions.answer_key: GitHub Actions secrets are protected configuration values scoped to repositories, environments, or organizations; access depends on context and policy.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of understanding github actions secrets: GitHub Actions secrets are protected configuration values scoped to repositories, environments, or organizations; access depends on context and policy. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: Store credentials in the appropriate protected secret store, pass them only to the step that needs them, and never print or save them in logs, summaries, artifacts, or caches.
questions.explanation: What a secret is: Store credentials in the appropriate protected secret store, pass them only to the step that needs them, and never print or save them in logs, summaries, artifacts, or caches. questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to understanding github actions secrets?
options: Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence. For this lesson, consider: GitHub Actions secrets are protected configuration values scoped to repositories, environments, or organizations; access depends on context and policy. A syntax check alone cannot prove remote execution, permissions, or deployment behavior.
